title: Intocable Sets Ceremony For Hollywood Walk of Fame Award
summary: The Latin music legends will receive the 2,852nd star during a ceremony next Thursday, July 16, in the category of “Recording.”
contentText:
Intocable will be saluted next week with a prime piece of real estate — a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.

Formed in the border town of Zapata, Texas, in the early 1990s, Intocable revolutionized Latin music, blending Tejano, Norteño, pop, rock, and cumbia “into a groundbreaking sound that has inspired generations,” reads a statement announcing their latest award. “Their influence is unmatched.”

The Latin music legends will receive the 2,852nd star during a ceremony next Thursday, July 16, in the category of “Recording.” Jessica Maldonado will emcee the ceremony, with Edgar Barrera and Nir Serrousi on hand as special guests.

The group has long ranked among regional Mexican music’s most durable hitmakers, with 15 No. 1s on  Billboard ’s  Top Regional Mexican Albums  chart and 21 No. 1s on  Regional Mexican Airplay , sold an estimated 55 million albums and collected multiple Grammys, Latin Grammys, Billboard awards, and lifetime achievement awards.

“For more than three decades, Intocable has helped shape the sound and global reach of regional Mexican music through their artistry, authenticity, and enduring connection with audiences,” remarks Ana Martinez, producer, Hollywood Walk of Fame. “The Hollywood Walk of Fame is proud to recognize their extraordinary contributions to the recording industry with this well- deserved honor.”

Outside of music, the group received a Proclamation for their enduring contributions to music and cultural impact from the Governor’s Office and the House of Representatives in Texas, and were named “Emissary of the Muses” by the city of San Antonio, a title previously awarded to the likes of Bon Jovi, Journey, and Placido Domingo.

The star is forged as Intocable continues its Cultura Tour 2026 , which visits 24 cities across the United States, Canada, and Mexico. Separately, the Tejano legends last month partnered with Primary Wave Music in a deal covering the band’s catalog as well as its name, image and likeness rights.

Intocable’s star is dedicated at 7083 Hollywood Boulevard.
